# Avinance Player packages

The two archives in this directory are **Avinance Player**, Avinance's proprietary media player
(`@avinance/muvi-player` and `@avinance/muvi-player-react`).

They are **not** covered by Muvi Lite's Apache 2.0 license. They are licensed only for use as an
integrated component of authorized Muvi Lite deployments, under
[PLAYER-LICENSE.md](../../../PLAYER-LICENSE.md). Do not extract, modify, redistribute separately or
use them outside Muvi Lite without written authorization from Avinance. See also
[NOTICE](../../../NOTICE).
